label: Mitochondrial intermediary metabolism: amino acids, sugars, FA oxidation
reason: Amino acid catabolism/urea cycle, carbohydrate metabolism (glycolysis, glycogen, galactose/fructose, PPP) and fatty acid beta-oxidation, all joined through pyruvate/TCA, with only a few strays (oxygen transport, metanephric tubule development, resveratrol response).

label: Ectodermal surface tissues: eye/retinoid, skin, pigmentation
reason: Clear blocks for phototransduction/retinoid cycle, keratinocyte/cornified envelope and MITF/melanosome pigmentation (plus ciliary transport), but about a fifth are unrelated (odontogenesis, saliva, luteolysis, vagina and bile duct development, TNF binding, synaptic vesicle coating, TBA).

label: Innate immune sensing: TLR/RLR, NF-kB, type I IFN
reason: Almost every member is pattern-recognition signaling (TLR, RIG-I/MDA5, NOD, cGAS/STING, inflammasome) leading to NF-kB/IRF and interferon responses, apart from a few generic transcription factor activity terms.

label: Systemic energy homeostasis: insulin secretion, adipose lipid storage
reason: Islet hormone secretion/insulin signaling, adipocyte differentiation and thermogenesis, and triglyceride/lipid droplet regulation via PPAR/LXR/SREBP form related sub-themes of metabolic endocrinology, with a few strays (hydroperoxide response, Golgi transport, SOS signaling).

label: Axon guidance, neural adhesion, myelination and neurotrophin death signaling
reason: Semaphorin/netrin/SLIT-ROBO/ephrin guidance and L1/NCAM adhesion, myelination/glial regulation and p75NTR dependence-receptor apoptosis are closely linked nervous system wiring sub-themes, with almost no outliers.

label: Mesodermal organogenesis: heart, vasculature, cartilage/bone, skeletal muscle
reason: Cardiac morphogenesis/valves, vascular development, chondrocyte/osteoblast (RUNX2) differentiation and myoblast/myogenesis are related mesoderm developmental programs, with a few generic or unrelated terms (ECM ligand sequestration, lung blood pressure, odontogenesis, TBA).

label: Reproduction: meiosis, gametogenesis, fertilization, maternal-zygotic transition
reason: Members cover meiotic recombination/synapsis, sperm and oocyte development, gonadal hormones, fertilization, piRNA silencing and MZT/ZGA, with a small set of unrelated items (neuron migration, mRNA export, TYSND1 peroxisomal cleavage, Nectin).

label: Developmental signaling: Wnt, Notch, TGF-beta/SMAD and cancer mutants
reason: A core of Wnt/beta-catenin, Notch and TGF-beta/SMAD signaling (including cancer mutants) shares the theme with sizeable unrelated blocks: estrogen/androgen/progesterone receptor signaling, PTK6 signaling, miRNA processing, and assorted transcription and RUNX3 terms.

label: Pan-metabolism catch-all: small molecules, glycans, mitochondria, RNA modification
reason: With 820 members it pools many separate blocks (amino acid/carbohydrate/lipid/nucleotide metabolism, glycosylation/CDG, GAG/MPS, heme, xenobiotic/drug ADME, vitamins, mitochondrial translation/OXPHOS, tRNA/rRNA modification), which share only the broad label 'metabolism'.

label: Lipoprotein, cholesterol and bile acid transport
reason: Chylomicron/VLDL/LDL/HDL assembly and clearance, cholesterol efflux/uptake via LXR/SREBP, and bile acid synthesis and recycling make one theme, apart from generic receptor internalization/endocytosis and glucose import terms.

label: Mitochondrial/peroxisomal metabolism: amino acids, FA oxidation, vitamin cofactors
reason: Amino acid catabolism/urea cycle, mitochondrial and peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation, and one-carbon/B-vitamin/sulfur/selenium cofactor metabolism are linked intermediary metabolism sub-themes, with a few strays (MGMT DNA repair, tube closure, melanin, HDL clearance, visual STRA6).

label: Mitochondrial gene expression, OXPHOS assembly and tRNA modification
reason: The core is mitochondrial transcription/translation, respiratory chain assembly and tRNA processing/modification, but a polyamine metabolism block, collagen/protein hydroxylation and basement membrane terms, plus A-to-I editing, diphthamide and Pol II elongation, are unrelated.

label: Musculoskeletal development: skeletal muscle, bone and cartilage
reason: Two clearly related blocks (myogenesis/muscle regeneration and contraction; osteoblast/chondrocyte/osteoclast and RUNX2 skeletal development) under a musculoskeletal idea, with a scattered tail of misfits (lithium, kinesins, netrin, motor neuron apoptosis, membrane raft, SCF proteolysis).

label: Systemic lipid and glucose metabolism; adipocytes, insulin, eicosanoids
reason: Members span lipoprotein/cholesterol handling, phospholipid and eicosanoid/SPM synthesis, and insulin/glucagon/adipocyte energy homeostasis, all metabolic-lipid related, with a minority of strays (Rho GTPase cycles, exocyst, blue light/UV-A, urea transport, mRNA transcription).

label: Lipid metabolism: eicosanoids, phospholipids, peroxisomal FA, retinoids/vision
reason: A lipid-metabolism umbrella combining eicosanoid/pro-resolving mediators and phospholipid remodeling, peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation plus isoprenoid/sterol synthesis, and retinoid metabolism with visual phototransduction, with few strays (histamine, GLUT1, GPCR clusters, succinyl-CoA).

label: Glycosylation, glycosaminoglycan and glycan-degradation disorders
reason: Clear core of N-/O-glycosylation, CDGs, GAG/proteoglycan synthesis, mucopolysaccharidoses and glycosphingolipids, but over 10% unrelated items (amyloid fibers, magnesium transport, reactive gliosis, type IV hypersensitivity, muscle fiber differentiation, CYP7B1/CYP2U1 defects, HSC migration).

label: Mitosis: chromosome cohesion, spindle/centrosome, nuclear envelope and pore
reason: Mitotic chromosome condensation/cohesion and spindle/centrosome control sit alongside nuclear envelope/NPC breakdown and reassembly, nucleocytoplasmic transport, and SUMOylation, all tied to mitotic nuclear dynamics, with few strays.

label: Nucleotide, one-carbon, methionine and polyamine metabolism
reason: Core of purine/pyrimidine synthesis and salvage, folate/methionine/SAM, selenium and polyamine metabolism plus tRNA modification, but a sizeable stray fraction (protein oligomerization terms, PGC-1alpha, diphtheria toxin, Vpr apoptosis, arylsulfatases, osmotic-stress apoptosis, mitochondrial depolarization).

label: Reproduction/germline plus viral life cycles
reason: Two unrelated blocks, gametogenesis/fertilization/early embryo and piRNA retroelement silencing versus viral entry, replication and protein maturation (SARS-CoV, RSV, Dengue, HIV, influenza), with no single idea linking them.

label: Innate immune sensing: TLR, NF-kB, interferon, inflammasome
reason: Overwhelmingly pattern-recognition and innate signaling (TLR/RLR/cGAS, NF-kB, type I IFN, inflammasome/pyroptosis, cytokine regulation), with only minor strays (vitamin D synthesis, osteoclast proliferation, oxLDL, tube lumen cavitation).

label: Proliferation megacluster: cell cycle, DNA repair, RNA processing, translation
reason: An 886-member catch-all spanning cell cycle/mitosis, DNA replication and repair, Pol I/II/III transcription, splicing/mRNA decay, rRNA/tRNA processing, translation, mitochondrial gene expression, chromatin, meiosis and HIV biology, far more than 2-3 sub-themes, so it does not resolve into one recognisable theme.

label: Gametogenesis/meiosis and microtubule machinery: spindle, centrosome, cilia
reason: Two related blocks: reproduction (meiosis, gametes, fertilization, gonad/ovary hormones, placenta, early embryo) and microtubule-based machinery (mitotic spindle, cohesion, centrosome, cilia/axoneme, tubulin folding), linked by meiotic division and sperm flagella; misfits include hepatocyte/liver regeneration, neuronal vesicle transport, presynapse, peroxisomal TYSND1, crotonylation.

label: RNA metabolism: transcription, processing, decay and translation
reason: Almost all members are Pol I/II/III transcription, splicing, capping/polyadenylation, mRNA decay, rRNA/tRNA/snRNA processing, miRNA silencing and translation initiation (with HIV Tat transcription as Pol II variants), with few misfits such as fibroblast proliferation, protein hydroxylation and TGFBR3 expression.

label: Neutrophil/phagocyte antibacterial defense and host-pathogen interaction
reason: Members are neutrophil degranulation/chemotaxis, respiratory burst, Fc-gamma phagocytosis, antimicrobial peptides/defensins, IL-17 mucosal defense and bacterial host-interaction pathways, with minor misfits (hyperoxia, translation initiation, GPCR cluster, SARS therapeutics).

label: ECM remodeling, angiogenesis and vascular smooth muscle/fibroblast biology
reason: Closely related sub-themes of collagen/integrin/ECM and TGF-beta/wound healing, endothelial VEGF/Tie angiogenesis, and vascular smooth muscle phenotype switching under vascular-stromal tissue remodeling, with very few misfits (protein oxidation, BACH1, fibrinogen levels).

label: Hematopoietic cytokine signaling and oncogenic RTK mutants/TKI resistance
reason: Two related blocks: JAK-STAT cytokine/EPO/CSF signaling with RUNX1-driven hematopoietic differentiation, and drug-resistant/fusion mutants of FLT3, KIT, PDGFR, ALK and FGFR receptor tyrosine kinases; nearly all members fit.

label: Innate inflammatory signaling: TLR/NF-kB, inflammasomes, IL-1 family
reason: Dominated by TLR/MyD88/TRIF, IKK/NF-kB, TAK1/MAPK, NOD, Dectin, inflammasome/pyroptosis and pro-inflammatory cytokine regulation, with a few off-theme entries (UV response, PI3K-AKT-mTOR, senescence, CD8 T cell proliferation).

label: Insulin/glucagon signaling, adipogenesis and lipid energy homeostasis
reason: Members cover insulin secretion and signaling, incretins/glucagon, adipocyte differentiation and thermogenesis, lipid droplets/triglyceride handling and PPAR/LXR/SREBP/ChREBP metabolic transcription, with few misfits (testosterone response, nucleotide catabolism).

label: Nucleotide metabolism, mitochondrial gene expression/OXPHOS, tRNA and base modification
reason: Several distinct blocks with no single unifying idea: purine/pyrimidine synthesis and salvage, mitochondrial translation/transcription and respiratory chain assembly, tRNA processing/modification, DNA base damage repair/demethylation, polyamine metabolism and protein methylation.

label: Cell cycle control: E2F/RB, p53 checkpoints and senescence
reason: Members are G1/S and G2/M transitions, APC/C, replication licensing, DNA damage checkpoints, TP53 regulation and target transcription, and oncogene/stress-induced senescence, with minor misfits (PAK-2p34, transcription termination, histone arginine methylation).

label: Glycosylation, glycoconjugate metabolism and congenital glycosylation disorders
reason: Clear core of N/O-glycosylation, dolichol/GPI synthesis, nucleotide-sugar metabolism, glycosphingolipid and GAG catabolism and CDG disease entries, plus about 11% unrelated members (amyloid fibers, CYP2U1/CYP7B1, magnesium transport, paranodal junction, polyufmylation, palmitoylation, type IV hypersensitivity).

label: Proteostasis: chaperones, ubiquitin-proteasome, autophagy and mitochondrial quality control
reason: Closely related sub-themes of chaperone/CCT folding and heat shock response, ubiquitin-proteasome degradation and selective autophagy, and mitochondrial import/dynamics/mitophagy under protein and organelle quality control, with few misfits (manganese/nitrogen responses, RHOBTB2).

label: RNA metabolism and host-virus gene expression, plus nuclear miscellany
reason: Large core of transcription, RNA processing/decay and translation joined by viral replication/host-gene-expression pathways and nuclear pore transport, but about 20% unrelated blocks (telomere maintenance, SUMOylation cascade, BAF complex assembly, Ig V(D)J/somatic hypermutation, glucokinase, BRAF fusions, lifespan).

label: Amino acid, one-carbon, sulfur and cofactor metabolism
reason: Members are amino acid synthesis/catabolism, folate/methionine/transsulfuration, glutathione, polyamines, selenium, NAD/B6/BH4 cofactors and related inborn errors, with only a few misfits (DNA protection, ketone bodies).

label: Embryonic axis patterning, gastrulation and craniofacial morphogenesis
reason: Members are gastrulation, germ layers, left/right and dorsal/ventral axis specification, HOX/somitogenesis, planar cell polarity and craniofacial/ear/limb morphogenesis, with few misfits (olfactory behavior, nail development, extracellular protein location).

label: Innate myeloid defense: complement, phagocytosis, antimicrobial, microglia/amyloid
reason: Complement, antimicrobial peptides, neutrophil/phagosome killing and pathogen manipulation form the core, with a related microglial activation/amyloid-beta clearance block; scattered misfits (amide metabolism obsoletes, chitin, protein import, axon regeneration, mucus secretion).

label: Xenobiotic, steroid hormone and bile acid CYP metabolism
reason: Strong core of CYP/UGT/SLCO-mediated drug, steroid, bile acid and vitamin D metabolism, but phosphate transport, bone/tooth mineralization and vitamin K gamma-carboxylation blocks plus scattered terms sit outside it.

label: Lipid metabolism: lipoproteins, phospholipids, sphingolipids, bile acids
reason: Lipoprotein assembly/clearance and cholesterol transport, glycerophospholipid synthesis/remodelling and sphingolipid/surfactant metabolism are related lipid sub-themes; misfits include endocytic receptor recycling, membrane bending and amide obsoletes.

label: Viral infection and host-virus interactions
reason: Nearly all members describe viral entry, replication, maturation, immune evasion (HIV, SARS-CoV, influenza, RSV, dengue, HCMV) and host antiviral restriction; few misfits like bacterial toxins and exosome assembly.

label: Mitochondrial energy metabolism: TCA, OXPHOS, cofactors
reason: TCA cycle, respiratory chain assembly, pyruvate/BCAA catabolism and mitochondrial cofactors (CoA, thiamine, lipoate, Fe-S, heme) form one mitochondrial metabolism theme; minor misfits like lanosterol, pregnenolone and vitamin E transport.

label: Intracellular membrane trafficking and organelle biogenesis
reason: ER-Golgi-endosome-lysosome vesicle transport, Rab/ARF regulation, phosphoinositide synthesis at membranes and melanosome/connexin trafficking cohere; misfits include voluntary movement, Lafora disease, erythrocyte enucleation and phosphatase regulation.

label: B and T lymphocyte activation and development
reason: BCR/TCR signaling, costimulation, B cell and thymocyte differentiation and lymphocyte BTMs form one adaptive lymphocyte theme; few misfits such as PECAM1, platelet LDL sensitization and KRAS_DN.

label: Adaptive immunity: lymphocytes, antigen presentation, IFN-gamma responses
reason: B/T/NK lymphocyte activation, MHC antigen processing/presentation with DCs and proteasome, and IFN/cytokine regulation are tightly related immune sub-themes with few misfits.

label: Cilia, vision/retinoids and sperm-fertilization biology
reason: Ciliogenesis/IFT, phototransduction-retinoid cycle and eye development, and sperm flagellum/acrosome/fertilization are linked via cilia and retinoid biology; misfits include uterus morphogenesis, luteolysis, blood-brain barrier and ECM signaling.

label: Hemostasis and eicosanoid lipid mediators
reason: Coagulation cascade, platelet activation and vitamin K carboxylation pair with prostaglandin/leukotriene/SPM lipid mediator synthesis and signaling; misfits include ichthyosis CYP4F22/SLC27A4, IGFBP transport, VEGFR2 and FOSL targets.

label: DNA repair, replication and telomere maintenance
reason: BER, NER, MMR, HR/NHEJ, translesion synthesis, replication and telomere maintenance form one genome-maintenance theme; minor misfits like chromosome Y BTM, editosome and UCH proteinases.

label: ER-Golgi secretory and endosomal vesicle trafficking
reason: COPI/COPII transport, Golgi organization, ER protein insertion/retention and endolysosomal sorting form a tight secretory pathway theme with very few misfits.

label: Cell cycle: mitosis, meiosis and DNA replication licensing
reason: APC/C regulation, G1/S and G2/M transitions, spindle/kinetochore, cohesion, cytokinesis and meiotic division form one cell division theme; few misfits like histone arginine methylation and Rho GTPase cycle.

label: Germline, fertilization and early embryo chromatin regulation
reason: Histone-modifying/BAF/PRC2 chromatin regulation, germ cell/piRNA biology and fertilization plus maternal-to-zygotic transition are linked by germline epigenetic reprogramming; misfits include SMAD2/3 downregulation, p75NTR, mRNA export and NER regulation.

label: Amino acid metabolism, urea cycle and glutathione
reason: Amino acid synthesis/catabolism, urea cycle disorders, glutathione synthesis and B6/BH4 cofactors cohere as nitrogen/amino acid metabolism; minor misfits like DNA protection, molybdenum cofactor and pyrimidine catabolism.

label: Cell cycle progression: E2F, G1/S and G2/M control
reason: E2F/MYC targets, replication licensing, APC/C mitotic exit, checkpoints and p53 cell-cycle arrest form one proliferation theme; few misfits like TFAP2A, MITF-M and histone arginine methylation.

label: Cell cycle, DNA replication and DNA repair
reason: Mitosis/checkpoints/E2F, replication origin licensing and the full range of DNA repair (BER, MMR, HR, NHEJ, NER, TLS) plus meiosis all sit under genome duplication and maintenance, with only scattered strays (ER insertion, erythrocyte enucleation, TCF7L2 mutants, TBAs).

label: GPCR cAMP signalling and visceral smooth muscle
reason: Adenylate cyclase/PKA-coupled adrenergic, muscarinic, serotonin and purinergic GPCR signalling, nicotinic receptors and the smooth-muscle physiology they control (gut, bladder, uterus) form related blocks; insemination, mating behaviour and agmatine biosynthesis are strays.

label: Retinoid, steroid, vitamin D and phosphate homeostasis
reason: Retinoid cycle/phototransduction, CYP-driven steroid and vitamin D/thyroid hormone metabolism, and phosphate/mineralization transporters form three links of nuclear-receptor-ligand and mineral biology, but mRNA transcription, propeptide removal, selenium metabolism and SLC26 anion-transport diseases are loose.

label: Neurotrophin signalling, glia/myelination and amyloid
reason: NTRK2/3 and p75NTR signalling dominates, joined by glial/oligodendrocyte myelination and microglial and amyloid-beta neurodegeneration terms, while obsolete amide metabolism, protein import and endosome transport terms do not fit.

label: Heart and vascular development
reason: Nearly all members cover cardiac morphogenesis (valves, septa, chambers, conduction system) and vessel development, with only TBAs, a TFAP2 term, replacement ossification and heterochronic development off-topic.

label: Ribosome biogenesis, Pol I/III transcription and splicing
reason: rRNA processing/modification with Pol I/III transcription and snRNA/spliceosome/mRNA 3'-end processing are clearly related arms of nuclear RNA processing; G0/G1 transition, inner cell mass, methionine response and TFAP2A are misfits.

label: Innate and adaptive immune responses
reason: The very large list consistently covers innate sensing/inflammation, cytokine signalling, complement, antigen presentation and lymphocyte activation, with a minority of strays (chitin metabolism, Golgi acidification, tube lumen cavitation, oncogenic fusion signalling, many TBAs).

label: Epithelial junctions, barrier and keratinocyte differentiation
reason: Adherens/tight junctions, desmosomes, polarity and cornified-envelope/keratinocyte terms form the core, but magnesium transport, MITF-M melanocyte gene regulation, hepatocyte nuclear factors, mechanosensing, light responses and many TBAs are unrelated.

label: Inflammasome, NF-kB/TLR signalling and regulated cell death
reason: TLR/IRAK/TAK1-NF-kB, inflammasome/pyroptosis, TNFR/TRAIL/Fas apoptosis and necroptosis make up one tightly connected innate inflammatory death-signalling theme with almost no strays.

label: RNA processing, decay and translation incl. mitochondrial
reason: Transcription by Pol I/II/III, splicing, mRNA export/decay, miRNA silencing, cytosolic and mitochondrial translation and tRNA processing all fall under gene-expression machinery; arylsulfatase activation, protein oxidation, fibroblast proliferation and TGFBR3 expression are strays.

label: Mitochondrial amino acid, fatty acid and TCA metabolism
reason: Amino acid catabolism/urea cycle with inborn errors, fatty acid beta-oxidation/carnitine/ketone bodies and TCA/pyruvate dehydrogenase metabolism are related arms of mitochondrial intermediary metabolism, with only proximal tubule development and Salla disease off-topic.

label: Innate antibacterial defense: complement, neutrophils, antimicrobial peptides
reason: Complement cascade, neutrophil/phagocyte and Fc-receptor effector functions, and antimicrobial peptide/IL-17 mucosal defense are related arms of innate host defense, with only a few strays (hyperoxia, heme signaling, intestinal stem cell homeostasis, LDL platelet sensitization).

label: Branching epithelial organogenesis: kidney, lung, mammary, prostate, pancreas
reason: Nearly all members describe epithelial-mesenchymal morphogenesis and lineage development of branched glandular organs (nephron/ureteric bud, lung, mammary, prostate, salivary, pancreas); few strays such as ductus arteriosus closure and lens fiber differentiation.

label: Receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to RAS-MAPK and PI3K-AKT
reason: EGFR/ERBB, MET, FGFR, PDGFR, ALK/LTK and PTK6 signaling plus their oncogenic RAS/RAF/MAPK mutants form one growth-factor signaling theme; minor strays include GPER1/estrogen and glycogen biosynthesis.

label: Axon guidance, neurotrophin signaling and myelination
reason: Axon guidance cues (netrin, SLIT-ROBO, semaphorin, ephrin, L1CAM), neurotrophin/TRK/p75NTR signaling and glial myelination are closely related sub-themes of nervous-system wiring.

label: Synaptic transmission, plasticity and neural behavior
reason: Pre- and postsynaptic organization, glutamate/GABA receptor signaling, LTP/memory, MECP2/NPAS4 activity-dependent transcription and behavior terms all belong to synaptic function; few strays like clathrin coat assembly and RHOF cycle.

label: Proteostasis: chaperone folding, UPR and ubiquitin-proteasome system
reason: Chaperonin/HSF1 folding, ER and mitochondrial UPR, integrated stress response, ubiquitination, DUBs and proteasome assembly are all protein quality control; minor strays include RHOBTB2 cycle and insulin processing.

label: Germ cells, meiosis, fertilization and reproduction
reason: Meiosis, spermatogenesis/oogenesis, fertilization, maternal-to-zygotic transition, piRNA transposon silencing and gonadotropin regulation form one reproductive biology theme, with rare strays like TYSND1 peroxisomal cleavage.

label: Lipoprotein, adipocyte and metabolic homeostasis
reason: A strong core of lipoprotein, cholesterol/bile acid, triglyceride, adipogenesis and insulin/glucose regulation is diluted by an amyloid-beta/microglia block and scattered strays (heme scavenging, NPAS4, ruffle assembly, immune complex clearance).

label: Complement, inflammasome/pyroptosis and antibacterial host defense
reason: Complement cascade, inflammasome/pyroptosis (CASP1/4/5, NLRP3, AIM2) and antibacterial effector/pathogen-manipulation pathways are related innate defense sub-themes; strays include MMP activation and elastin/ECM catabolism.

label: SLC solute transport and phosphate/vitamin D mineralization
reason: SLC transporter function and its disease variants dominate, joined by related blocks on erythrocyte gas/bicarbonate exchange and phosphate-vitamin D-driven bone/tooth mineralization; strays include lactose synthesis and lens transparency.

label: Retinoid vision, pigmentation and epidermal differentiation
reason: Phototransduction/retinoid cycle, melanocyte/MITF pigmentation and keratinocyte cornification are linked via retinoid and pigment biology, but intestinal epithelium, HNF and leukocyte migration terms are unrelated and many members are uninformative TBA modules.

label: Antiviral innate immunity and type I interferon response
reason: Nucleic-acid sensing (RIG-I, cGAS-STING, TLR3/7/8/9), IRF3/7 activation, interferon signaling and ISG effectors form one antiviral theme; minor strays include TP53 caspase transcription and STAT6 chemokines.

label: Lymphocyte activation, cytokine signaling and Fc/mast cell responses
reason: B and T cell receptor signaling/differentiation, interleukin/JAK-STAT cytokine signaling and FcR/mast-eosinophil type-2 responses are related adaptive immune sub-themes; strays include CNTF, erythropoietin and LDL platelet sensitization.

label: Membrane trafficking: ER-Golgi, endolysosomal, ESCRT and autophagy
reason: COPI/COPII and Golgi transport, endosome sorting/ESCRT, lysosome biogenesis and autophagy are tightly related membrane-trafficking sub-themes, with few strays such as ERBB signaling regulation.

label: Mitotic and meiotic chromosome segregation machinery
reason: Spindle/centrosome assembly, sister chromatid cohesion, condensation, cytokinesis and meiotic recombination/synapsis form closely related cell-division sub-themes; strays include non-motile cilium assembly and Rho GTPase cycle.

label: Membrane lipid and peroxisomal fatty acid metabolism
reason: Phospholipid synthesis/remodeling, sphingolipid, cholesterol biosynthesis, GPI anchor and peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation/import are one lipid metabolism theme; few strays like succinyl-CoA catabolism and CYP1B1 glaucoma.

label: Apoptosis, p53 signaling and cellular senescence
reason: Intrinsic/extrinsic apoptosis, TP53 transcriptional regulation and oncogene/stress-induced senescence are tightly linked cell-fate sub-themes; strays include allograft rejection and T-cell signaling modules.

label: Monoamine and cholinergic neurotransmitter synthesis, release, reuptake
reason: Catecholamine/serotonin/acetylcholine/GABA/glutamate synthesis, vesicular release, reuptake and clostridial toxin SNARE cleavage are all presynaptic neurotransmission; only SLC bile acid transport is off.

label: Glutamatergic synapse assembly and synaptic plasticity
reason: AMPA/NMDA/kainate receptor signaling, postsynaptic density organization, LTP/LTD, MECP2/CREB activity-dependent transcription and memory form a single synaptic plasticity theme.

label: Ion channels, osmoregulation and chemosensory perception
reason: Three related physiology blocks (K+/TRP channels and membrane excitability, renal salt/water and vasopressin-aquaporin homeostasis, taste/smell/pain sensory perception) share an ion-transport/sensory theme, with a few strays such as fatty acid transport/cycling, oleoyl-phe metabolism, intestinal infectious diseases and GnRH neuron migration.

label: RTK signaling to RAS-MAPK/PI3K and oncogenic TKI resistance
reason: Almost entirely receptor tyrosine kinase signaling (FGFR, ERBB, MET, KIT, FLT3, PDGFR, ALK) through RAS-MAPK and PI3K-AKT, including oncogenic mutants and drug-resistant variants; only a few strays like integrin biosynthesis, glycogen biosynthesis, synoviocyte proliferation and diphtheria toxin.

label: Nervous system development, axon guidance and neurobehavior
reason: Dominated by axon guidance (netrin, SLIT/ROBO, semaphorin, ephrin, L1CAM), neuronal/glial differentiation, myelination and brain region development, with neural behavior terms fitting the same theme; few strays such as ceramide signalling, fungiform papilla morphogenesis and organism emergence.

label: FGFR/ERBB/MET signaling via RAS-MAPK and PI3K
reason: A tight growth-factor RTK set (FGFR1-4, ERBB2/3/4, EGFR, MET) with downstream SHC/GRB2/FRS, RAS-RAF-MAPK and PI3K cascades and their oncogenic mutants; only integrin biosynthetic process is clearly off-topic.

label: Embryonic development and organogenesis (very broad)
reason: Nearly all members are developmental (heart, kidney, neural, muscle, skeleton, lung, mammary/pancreas lineages, gastrulation, left-right patterning, Hh/Wnt/BMP), united only at the broad level of morphogenesis and spanning far more than 2-3 sub-themes, with strays like amyloid fiber formation, ORC assembly, olfactory receptors, EDA-ID/IKBKG and TNF receptor binding.

label: Phospholipid, eicosanoid and neutral lipid metabolism
reason: Related lipid blocks (glycerophospholipid synthesis and acyl-chain remodelling, eicosanoid/SPM lipid mediator synthesis and receptors, sphingolipid and triglyceride/lipid droplet metabolism) form one lipid-metabolism idea, with misfits such as cornified envelope assembly, cristae formation, cytochrome metabolism, peptide modification and histamine metabolism.
